documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Bajaj Auto Limited reported its highest-ever quarterly performance in Q3 FY26, with top line crossing INR15,000 crores at 19% growth, EBITDA at INR3,161 crores, and PAT at INR2,503 crores. The strong performance was driven by supportive environments like GST rate cuts, robust domestic and export volumes, and recovery in electric vehicles and commercial vehicles. Management highlighted ongoing product interventions in the Pulsar portfolio, export momentum, and a turnaround plan for newly acquired step-down subsidiary KTM AG. Additionally, the company's captive finance subsidiary BACL delivered strong results with an AUM exceeding INR16,000 crores and a quarterly PAT of INR200 crores.

guidance.claim: The company expects the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at 12% to 15%.
guidance.quote: We expect this growth momentum in the industry to continue and the motorcycle industry to continue to grow at, say, 12% to 15%.

guidance.claim: Management expects export growth tempo to continue in the coming months and aims to deliver the highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.
guidance.quote: Overall, the Exports business has established a sustained growth momentum, and we expect this growth tempo to continue in the coming months. In fact, the business is on the path to deliver its highest ever top line performance in USD terms this financial year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus and 150cc plus segments.
guidance.quote: Therefore, we expect to outpace industry growth in the 125cc plus segment and particularly in the 150cc plus segment and continue on the path of market share acquisition, which has commenced a couple of months ago.

guidance.claim: Management expects to grow its leadership position decisively in the coming quarters in electric commercial vehicles.
guidance.quote: We expect to grow our leadership position quite decisively in the coming quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the top 30 overseas markets grew by about 10% in the quarter while company sales grew at 15%.
demand_outlook.quote: The top 30 overseas markets collectively accounting for nearly 75% of the emerging market, industry grew by about 10% in this quarter with our sales growing at 15%, thereby signalling an increase of market share in these key markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The motorcycle industry grew by about 15% post GST rationalization in Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: But post the GST rationalization, Q3 has grown by about 15% in the industry.

demand_outlook.claim: Export volumes crossed the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.
demand_outlook.quote: The BU crossed the 200,000 average per month sales level in October '25 after nearly 40 months and maintained this level through the remainder of the quarter, surpassing the 600,000 units mark after 15 quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: Combined Pro-Biking volumes reached over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year.
demand_outlook.quote: The 2 brands together delivered a record domestic performance with combined volumes of over 35,000 units, registering robust growth of around 50% year-on-year and marking the highest-ever quarterly performance for the business, lifted also by the positive sentiment.

capex_expansion.claim: The company strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during the first 9 months into its Netherlands subsidiary BAIHBV and in the growth of BACL.
capex_expansion.quote: We have strategically invested slightly above INR2,300 crores during this 9-month period into our Netherlands subsidiary, BAIHBV which you would recall was partly to fund the KTM acquisition and in the growth of BACL, which has steadily grown in scale and footprint.

capex_expansion.claim: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came close to the 10,000 mark supported by expanded production capacities.
capex_expansion.quote: Sales in Bajaj Brazil came in close to 10,000 mark, supported by expanded production capacities and the subsidiary is now delivering a healthy bottom line performance too.

capex_expansion.claim: The distribution network for Chetak expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.
capex_expansion.quote: The scale-up was also supported by distribution network that expanded to nearly 450 exclusive Chetak stores and 4,000 points of sale across 800 cities and towns.

capex_expansion.claim: Joint KTM-Triumph showrooms are planned to expand to over 100 by March.
capex_expansion.quote: We currently have about 50 KT showrooms operational and plan to expand these to over 100 by March.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins expanded to 20.8%, up 30 basis points sequentially.

margins_costs.claim: The EV business delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics.
margins_costs.quote: More importantly, the EV business now delivers double-digit EBITDA margin while improving unit economics as the portfolio continues to scale.

margins_costs.claim: The net price versus cost inflation hit was nearly 50 basis points on the margin.
margins_costs.quote: As a result, we saw a net price versus cost inflation hit of nearly 50 basis points on the margin.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax after the onetime wage adjustment stood at INR2,503 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Therefore, profit after tax after this onetime adjustment stood at INR2,503 crores, rising 19% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company maintains a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an 85% plus share in the CNG segment.
orders_capacity.quote: We continue to maintain a 70% plus market share in the ICE segment with an overwhelming share of 85% plus in the CNG segment, which is the largest segment within ICE.

capital_allocation.claim: The company closed the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to deliver strong and consistent cash generation, closing the quarter with surplus cash of about INR15,000 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: In the first 9 months of the year, the company generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, up 70% over the same period last year.
capital_allocation.quote: It's also worth noting that in the first 9 months of this year, we've generated nearly INR5,200 crores of free cash flow, and that was up 70% over the same period last year, reflecting our strong track record of converting profit to cash.

capital_allocation.claim: The last capital infusion into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores as Tier 2 capital.
capital_allocation.quote: The last infusion we did into BACL was in October of about INR300 crores. And that we think is absolutely the last of it that is needed. In fact, that infusion also went in as Tier 2 capital.

risks_headwinds.claim: Noble metals including platinum, palladium, and rhodium saw sharp increases, while aluminium, copper, nickel, and lead continued to harden.
risks_headwinds.quote: Noble Metals especially platinum, palladium and rhodium all saw sharp increases, whilst aluminium, copper, nickel and lead also continued to harden.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards past service cost arising from new labour code wage definitions.
risks_headwinds.quote: As you're all aware, pursuant to the amendment in the definition of wages under the new labour code, we recognized INR61 crores as a onetime exceptional charge towards the past service cost arising from the changes introduced under the new labour code.

management_commitments.claim: The top management team exercise for KTM AG will be completed by April 1st.
management_commitments.quote: Second, build the top management team. The top deck is now largely in place, and the exercise will be completed by 1st April.
